issues.reason: All song levels 0–6 have been indexed, but individual song descriptions and complete spellcasting mechanics require validation. This index is not an approved gameplay implementation.
These entries contain short source-index paraphrases. Individual song detail pages, saves, durations, costs, mechanics and edge cases require independent review.
Maintained songs require per-round management, targeting, ongoing saves/resistance and the Medley class feature; not yet implemented in the save or combat engine.
Song learning must validate Bard level, Charisma, existing songs, MP and orchestration rolls; player selections remain disabled until the Bard adapter is built.

rules.tieredSongs: Different song-level versions are distinct learned entries; not class ability upgrade events.
